I walked in by chance, checked the reviews, and saw that the seller had a perfect 5.0 rating. Based on that, I decided to buy the product. The seller claimed it was a good item, and I paid the upper/regular market price for this kind of product in touristic part of Thailand.
Unfortunately, the quality was very mediocre. I honestly don’t understand where all the 5-star reviews came from. The effect was quite underwhelming, and the taste was questionable — dry and straw-like.
Overall, I don’t think it’s worth the money. The number of high ratings is very surprising considering the actual quality.
